channel.title: The Sun Media Corporation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: From rice to fries: Southeast Asia’s appetite for potatoes surges
item.description: Southeast Asia's potato consumption has soared by 20% in a decade, driven by urbanisation and modern retail, with Indonesia leading regional production.

item.title: Senai-Desaru Expressway upgrade 55% complete, on track for 2027
item.description: The RM160 million project to widen the Senai-Desaru Expressway to four lanes is progressing smoothly and is scheduled for completion in April 2027.

item.title: Thaipusam draws crowds with vibrant rituals and cultural harmony
item.description: Thaipusam celebrations across Malaysia attracted thousands of devotees and tourists, showcasing vibrant rituals and the nation's multicultural spirit.

item.title: Police investigate viral claim of assault during Dungun traffic op
item.description: Terengganu police are probing a viral claim that a man was beaten by officers during a traffic operation, with the chief vowing no protection for any guilty personnel.

item.title: Volkanovski outlasts Lopes again to retain UFC featherweight crown
item.description: Alexander Volkanovski defended his UFC featherweight title with a hard-fought unanimous decision win over Diego Lopes in a Sydney rematch.

item.title: US lawmakers, Musk slam limited Epstein document release
item.description: Lawmakers and public figures criticise the partial release of Jeffrey Epstein-linked documents, accusing the Justice Department of withholding legally required information.

item.title: Two men arrested over knife and drone offences during Thaipusam
item.description: Police detain a man for carrying a knife and an elderly man for flying a drone without a permit during the Thaipusam festival in Ipoh.

item.title: RM179 million in subsidised goods seized since 2024
item.description: Ops Tiris has seized nearly RM179 million in subsidised goods since 2024, with petrol, diesel and cooking oil the most diverted items.

item.title: Police investigate actor’s historical sex abuse claim
item.description: Kuala Lumpur police confirm a report from a male actor alleging he was a victim of unnatural sex acts as a child actor.

item.title: Trump welcomes Chinese investment in Venezuelan oil
item.description: US President Donald Trump says he would welcome Chinese investment in Venezuela's oil sector as the country seeks to revive its economy.
